As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll be part of the Technology Architecture team in Basware IT. You'll design and develop the foundations of our enterprise data platform, directly impacting analytics, platform development, and business decisions. Your work will help build resilient, compliant, and scalable infrastructure that enables fast and confident delivery of data products across the enterprise.

What You'll Do

• Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and storage layers following a medallion architecture (landing → bronze → silver), operating as the enterprise tenant within our multi-tenant data platform and unified enterprise metastore
• Develop and operate pull-based data ingestion flows using Azure Data Factory and custom Python-based API connectors to land data from diverse enterprise source systems
• Build and maintain transformation pipelines with strong focus on data quality, lineage, and observability from landing zone through to consumption-ready layers
• Implement data security features including PII masking, tenant isolation, and retention policies in line with enterprise compliance requirements
• Collaborate with data product teams and enterprise stakeholders to drive self-service adoption and best practices
• Establish monitoring, alerting, and cost tracking integrations for pipeline operations
• Contribute to infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices for platform deployment and management

,

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience building scalable, maintainable, and self-service data solutions
• Strong background in batch and streaming pipeline design, orchestration, and schema management
• Hands-on experience with Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake), Apache Spark, and Python/SQL
• Experience with Azure cloud services, particularly Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and related data integration tooling
• Deep understanding of data quality validation and monitoring frameworks
• Familiarity with medallion architecture patterns and layered data processing
• Excellent collaboration skills across engineering, product, and enterprise stakeholder teams
• Proven ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code
• Strong problem-solving mindset
• Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted coding: spec-driven development, systematic validation of AI-generated output (functional and technical), and a controlled-adopter approach — AI amplifies productivity, the human owns every line that ships.

We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning.

Nice to Have

• Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
• Familiarity with multi-tenant data architectures, catalog-level isolation, and enterprise data governance
• Experience building or integrating pull-based ingestion patterns from APIs, ERPs, or other enterprise systems
• Exposure to Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) or similar deployment frameworks

About Groww:
We are a passionate group of people focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian through a multi-product platform. Each day, we help millions of customers take charge of their financial journey. Customer obsession is in our DNA. Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Everyone at Groww is driven by ownership, customer-centricity, integrity and the passion to constantly challenge the status quo.
 
Are you as passionate about defying conventions and creating something extraordinary as we are? Let’s chat.
 
Our Vision
Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting-edge multi-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians.
 
Our Values
Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.
The values that form our foundation are:
  • Radical customer centricity
  • Ownership-driven culture
  • Keeping everything simple
  • Long-term thinking
  • Complete transparency

About the Role

We seek an experienced, results-driven purchasing manager to join our team at Groww. As a purchase manager, you will be responsible for handling the procurement process, sourcing suppliers and managing vendor relationships to ensure a seamless supply chain and optimise costs. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams, make strategic decisions and implement best practices within our procurement function.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to our company's success and be part of a dynamic team in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement procurement strategies and policies for cost optimization and supply chain efficiency
  • Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers based on quality, cost-effectiveness, and ethical standards
  • Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure favorable pricing and mutually beneficial agreements
  • Manage supplier relationships, including performance evaluation, issue resolution, and long-term partnership building
  • Conduct market research and analysis to stay updated on industry trends and pricing fluctuations
  • Monitor inventory levels, analyze demand patterns, and implement inventory management strategies
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and align procurement with organizational goals
  • Implement procurement systems and tools to streamline processes and enhance efficiency
  • Analyze and present procurement reports, performance metrics, and cost-saving opportunities to management
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and promote ethical and sustainable sourcing practices
  • Develop procurement metrics to track performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Manage Admin, HR, IT, and Marketing spends

Preferred skills and qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or a related field.
  • 2+ years in procurement/purchasing in a fast-paced, competitive environment in the Indian market.
  • In-depth knowledge of procurement principles, strategies and best practices.
  • Strong skills in budgeting, cost optimisation and negotiation techniques.
  • Knowledge of vendor management and inventory management systems.
  • An analytical mind with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in using procurement software and systems.
  • Knowledge of local and national laws and regulations related to procurement.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced and competitive environment.
  • Knowledge of Admin , HR, IT , Marketing Spends.

Associate Support Engineer

What we’re looking for
SMG is looking for an Associate Support Engineer to provide front-line operational and technical support across our products and services. You’ll help clients resolve everyday application, access, configuration, reporting, and troubleshooting needs while partnering with internal teams when issues require deeper expertise. This role is a strong fit for someone who combines technical curiosity, careful execution, and clear communication to keep client requests moving and deliver high-quality support experience.

What you’ll do

• Handle client requests through tickets and calls, resolving operational and technical issues while delivering a high-quality customer experience.

• Support day-to-day client needs including password resets, user access requests, standard configuration updates, basic reporting changes, and common troubleshooting requests.

• Use established documentation, tools, and troubleshooting steps to resolve routine application, configuration, and web-based issues.

• Gather complete diagnostic information for issues outside your scope and route them to the appropriate team to support efficient resolution.

• Follow up with clients and internal stakeholders on open requests, maintaining accurate ticket notes, documentation, and status updates.

• Perform quality control testing on support changes and client deliverables to confirm outputs are accurate and aligned to requirements.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to clarify business needs, support deliverables, and maintain alignment with product, process, and quality standards.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to documentation, templates, tools, and work processes while building knowledge of SMG products, tools, and technologies.
What success looks like

• Within 30 days, build working knowledge of SMG products, support tools, documentation, and standard processes, and begin resolving routine client requests with appropriate guidance.

• Within 60 days, independently manage a consistent volume of common support requests, document work accurately, and escalate more complex issues with complete diagnostic information.

• Within 90 days, deliver reliable front-line support across common client needs, contribute improvements that reduce repeat issues or increase efficiency, and participate effectively in required application support coverage.
Why you’ll love SMG

• We work with some of the world’s biggest and most valued brands.

• We’re fully remote, and we’re staying that way.

• We offer competitive compensation and benefits, which include but aren’t limited to:

• Unlimited PTO

• Extended parental leave

• Company-issued equipment and tools

• A culture built on connection, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll bring

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in technical customer support or service delivery.

• Experience supporting and troubleshooting applications or large-scale systems, including web-based applications.

• Working knowledge of application configuration, web-based platforms, support tools, and basic technical concepts such as HTML, SQL, data modeling, or system process design.

• Strong written and verbal communication, troubleshooting, prioritization, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and participate in application support coverage as business needs require.
Preferred:
• Experience supporting applications in a SaaS environment.Who we are
SMG is an experience management (XM) partner to many of the world’s leading restaurant, retail, and consumer services brands.
With 30+ years of history under our belt, we pair an AI-native enterprise software platform with unmatched professional services to help organizations generate new revenue, grow existing revenue, reduce detractors, and drive operational efficiencies.
Like what you see? Learn more about the company, our purpose and values, and our customer, employee, and brand experience management solutions at www.smg.com.
Our commitment to inclusion: SMG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Role Summary:

Role Summary:
Raise is built on this core philosophy — we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user experience and best-in-class customer service to our users.

We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021. Today, Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026, Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival, reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who is passionate about customers, technology, data and building great consumer products. You will work closely with customers to understand their needs, identify product gaps and translate those insights into simple, intuitive and impactful product experiences.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role where you will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth, Business and other teams to take products from problem discovery and ideation through execution, launch and continuous improvement.
The ideal candidate is curious, analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to go deep into customer problems, use data to make decisions and bring multiple teams together to get things done.

Expected Responsibilities:

• Understand customer needs and behaviour through customer conversations, data, market research and product insights, and identify opportunities to improve the product experience.
• Own product initiatives from problem identification and ideation through requirements, development, launch and post-launch optimisation.
• Define product requirements, user journeys, specifications and success metrics in collaboration with Design, Engineering, Data and Business teams.
• Work closely with Engineering and Design to prioritise, build and ship high-quality product experiences within defined timelines.
• Track product and business metrics, identify gaps and translate data into actionable product improvements.
• Develop and maintain product roadmaps, prioritising initiatives based on customer impact, business value, effort and strategic priorities.
• Drive product launches and coordinate with Product, Engineering, Design, Growth, Marketing, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.
• Continuously evaluate the product post-launch, identify opportunities for improvement and drive enhancements that improve customer experience, adoption, engagement and business outcomes.
• Take end-to-end ownership of the product experience, including customer journeys, operational workflows, data, processes and day-to-day product performance.
• Partner with Growth and Marketing teams to ensure product communication, positioning and go-to-market plans are aligned with the product strategy.
• Represent the voice of the customer within the organisation and ensure customer insights influence product priorities and decisions.
• Build strong relationships across teams, create alignment and drive initiatives with a high level of ownership and urgency.

Expected Skills:

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in Product Management, preferably in a consumer-facing internet, fintech or technology business.
• Experience in defining, building and shipping consumer-facing digital products.
• Experience working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth and Business teams.
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to identify problems, evaluate opportunities and make decisions.
• Strong understanding of customer behaviour, product journeys and user experience.
• Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into simple, actionable solutions.
• Strong product sense with an eye for detail, usability and customer experience.
• Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive execution across multiple teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate the “why” behind product decisions.
• Passion for financial services, investing, trading and fintech. Prior experience in investing, wealth, broking, banking, payments or financial services will be an advantage.
• High ownership, bias for action and comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous and constantly evolving environment.
• An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred but not mandatory. We value strong product thinking, execution capability, analytical ability and demonstrated impact over credentials.

We are a start-up and focused on fast growth with quality products hence the ability to work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

Our People & Culture
People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.
We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and demonstrate following personality traits:
• Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.
(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)
• We have a single opportunity to serve.
(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product, uptimes, customer service, or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)
• Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.
(The only way to get respect is to give it first)
• Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.
(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)
• Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.
(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our customers, not to prove a point.)
• Quality over quantity.
(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)
• Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.
(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)
• Talent and Competency over Credentials.
• Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.
(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)
• Less words, more action.
(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)
• Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.
(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)
• Passionate about the business you are a part of.
(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)
• Raise is an equal opportunity employer. 
(We celebrate diversity and inclusion.)

Why Join Raise?
We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. 90103446c3a6251f.description: Product Manager, Advanced Enterprise Data Platform Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role. 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc). Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in a technology or business related field. Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure. Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross-functional stakeholders. Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long-term product roadmaps. Deep knowledge of AI/ML foundations, RAG, and semantic modeling. Ability to define platform success metrics from user feedback while ensuring strict data privacy and security compliance. About the job At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Googles data landscape into an AI-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross-functional domains to drive product-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Googles next generation of agentic intelligence. At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Googles IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers. Responsibilities Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem. Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges. Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide-ranging enterprise requirements. Engage directly with domain owners to lead platform adoption, optimize common capabilities, and achieve product-market fit. Define satisfaction metrics through user feedback while navigating ambiguity to maintain enterprise standards and high-impact delivery. Experience Level Mid Level .
